sentences.en: He selected a pair of socks to match his suit.
sentences.zh: 他挑选了一双袜子来配他的西装。

sentences.en: He was proud that he was selected by the people.
sentences.zh: 他为自己被人民选中而感到自豪。

sentences.en: Elite soldiers are almost always selected among the special forces.
sentences.zh: 精英士兵几乎总是从特种部队中选拔出来的。

senses.zh: 经由选择的，挑选的v.选择，挑选( select的过去式和过去分词 )
